title: DeliveryTombstoneV2
description: Server-signed proof that a message reached the server. It is the SERVER_ACCEPTED receipt from /v1/ingest, carried unchanged over the mesh. Verify: Ed25519(bundled receipt public key, UTF-8 'SERVER_ACCEPTED|' + messageId + '|' + packetHash + '|' + timestamp). Mesh lifetime: timestamp + 72 h. Never created by a peer ACK.

timestamp.description: Exact string signed by the server (ISO-8601 UTC, ms).

hopsLeft.description: Not signed. Gateway sets 8; each forward decrements; 0 = keep but do not forward.
